title: AquaTerra in December 2025: {count} drives, carols and cookies
description: AquaTerra's December 2025: {count} drives, Merry Miracles sessions, Cookie Pass On drives, a Sundarbans trip and the Starry Night winter fundraiser.
lede: In December 2025 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. Christmas shaped much of the month: Merry Miracles sessions and carols at Pather Sathi, stocking decoration and Santa masks, and four Cookie Pass On drives across apartments and Barrackpore. The month also held the Starry Night winter fundraiser and a trip to the Sundarbans with Pather Sathi.

sections.heading: a fortnight of christmas sessions
body: The Christmas sessions ran from 13 to 21 December. Merry Miracles Day 1 on 13 December at Pather Sathi had children make Christmas greeting cards. On 14 December Merry Miracles Day 2 taught carols as an interactive activity, and Christmas Carols and Storytelling ran at the same place with children singing, cake and classic Christmas stories.

Santa Mask Making, part of Merry Miracles 3, ran at AIM Foundation on 17 December. Stocking Decoration at Amader Pradakhep on 20 December had children make their own stockings, and the team then handed out cake and filled the stockings with chocolates. Art & Craft at Pather Sathi on 21 December taught public speaking through storytelling and art. The [festival drives page](/impact/festival-drives) covers the wider run of seasonal work.

sections.heading: cookie pass on, four times
body: Cookie Pass On ran four times in December: at Avani Oxford and Astitva Apartment on 15 December, at Silver Spring Apartment on 18 December and at Barrackpore on 22 December. Each stop was a small team handing out cookies and asking residents to pass one on.
The idea is a chain of kindness. The write-ups say the residents were encouraged to pass the cookie on to someone who needed it.

sections.heading: starry night and a collab at Science City
body: Starry Night '25 at Sky Turf on 26 December was AquaTerra's flagship winter fundraiser, a night of music that brought hundreds together for giving back. The money raised from the nights goes back into the welfare drives, and the [fundraising page](/impact/fundraising) explains how they fit together.
On 18 December the Aq x Vishwajagriti and Emami collaboration at Science City distributed stationery kits and hosted a group of children. The write-up says 300 stationery kits were distributed.

sections.heading: a trip to the Sundarbans
body: Sunderbans 8.0 ran on 13 December, with Pather Sathi, and it had the second-largest team of the month. The write-up says medical checkups were held, and that medicines and stationery were donated. The [Sundarbans page](/impact/sundarbans) covers the series and what the trips have involved over time.
The trip sits in the same month as the Christmas sessions and the winter fundraiser, which shows how the work runs across very different kinds of day.

sections.heading: how december compares
body: October ran {count:month-2025-10} drives and March 2026 ran {count:month-2026-03}, so December sat between a short autumn of Diwali work and a spring of its own. Many of the month's drives were festive, and Pather Sathi came back more than any other place. The [October 2025 page](/impact/month-2025-10) covers the Diwali sessions before it.

learnings: Festive sessions can be built on a few repeat formats: carols and cake each turned up in more than one session.
A small drive can travel well. Cookie Pass On ran at four places in one month, each with a small team and the same chain of kindness.
Pather Sathi hosted four December sessions, so a new member who joins in winter is likely to start there.
Starry Night and Sunderbans 8.0 both ran in December, which shows that a fundraiser and a field trip can share one month.
